title: LocalUniformHigherDirectImageBound
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and let $s\in S$. There are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $s$ and $n\in\mathbf N$ such that, for every quasi-coherent module $M$ on $X$ [pqf-def-coherent] and every $p\ge n$, the restriction of $R^p f_*M$ to $U$ is zero. Here $R^p f_*$ is the ordinary right derived module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image, def-sc-open-module-cohomology]. No quasi-compactness assumption is made on $S$, and $U,n$ are chosen before $M$.

source.place: Tag 01XJ, proof of (3), affine-base finite-cover argument; induction form via Tag 08DR and Tag 01EB

proof.text: Choose an affine open neighbourhood U of s. Its inverse image Y is quasi-compact by quasi-compactness of f and quasi-separated since f is quasi-separated and U is affine. Apply quasi-compact-open induction on Y to the property P(W): there is n_W such that, for every affine T -> U and every quasi-coherent G on T times_U W, all H^p vanish for p >= n_W. The empty open is included.
For W affine take n_W=1: a fibre product of affine schemes over affine U is affine, so affine vanishing applies after every affine base change.

For W1 union W2 use bounds a,b,c for W1, W2, W1 intersection W2. Base change preserves their union and intersection. Restrict G to the three opens; these restrictions remain quasi-coherent. Mayer-Vietoris puts H^p of the union between H^(p-1) of the intersection and H^p of the two opens, all zero for p >= max(a,b,c)+1. Induction gives one bound on Y, independent of G and T.

Apply this bound to every affine open T inside U, which is an affine base change of Y -> U. Restrict M and its injective resolution. The resulting open cohomology groups vanish uniformly. Higher direct image is the sheafification of this cohomology presheaf; vanishing on the affine neighbourhood basis makes each stalk zero and hence the restriction of R^p f_*M to U zero. Open restriction of module resolutions identifies the computed group with the ordinary right derived moduleDirectImage in the statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_uniform_higherDirectImage_bound
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (s : S) :
    ∃ (U : S.Opens) (n : ℕ), s ∈ U ∧
      ∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)), M.IsQuasicoherent →
        ∀ p : ℕ, n ≤ p → IsZero
          (Scheme.Modules.restrict
            (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj M)
            U.ι)
